content:
Although some of the larger fall Prime Day discounts on Apple products have not yet begun, there are already plenty of eye-catching deals available to snap up, including a $500 off the M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 2TB of storage, the all-new Beats 360 over-ear headphones Cushion Kit bundle at 20% off, and AirTag 2 at a low price on Amazon.

We are also tracking official fall Prime Day discounts from some of our favourite HomeKit smart home brands, including ecobee, plus a wide range of Eve smart plugs, power strips, switches and more, as well as new low prices on several Belkin 25W MagSafe chargers. While you're here, be sure to check out the popular new Twelve South Airfly Drive wireless CarPlay adapter for just $40.
